change: Add VALUES to the named-construct list and define general declarative IF/THEN truth behavior.

r1931_path_escape.interpretation: The existing obligation that a backslash escapes the next literal name character concerns unquoted Subject path names. R2487 limits escapes within double-quoted text to \" and \\. These are distinct contexts; the path escape alone does not conflict.
r1931_path_escape.limits: This does not introduce quoted path-name segments, and does not close other R1931 quote, scope, or example holds.

boundary: No native source mutation. Drafts and coordinated migration remain distinct from Current authority.

if_then_obligation_matrix.result: Every complete expression in matching THEN body holds.
Existing IF binding, scope, and no-shadow rules remain; R2552 addresses membership and edge existence specifically.

known_existing_draft_issue: CA-R-2552@5 says its model binding rule does not introduce a FOR operator; FOR EACH has since been separately approved and declared in R2778. Its context is not a general prohibition, but check clarity during coordinated migration.
